final:
-- Test job used by the ex line: a plain function the caller passes as a closure.
sample_job() -> str = "x"

-- Wraps the job's result as "start:" + result + ":end".
-- Declares no capabilities: any the job captures belong to the caller.
wrapped(job: () -> str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() >= 10
  ex wrapped(sample_job) == "start:x:end"
  "start:" + job() + ":end"
